verdict.rationale: Feature-status and ingestion docs say materialized views (incremental transforms on insert) and refreshable materialized views (scheduled re-computation) are supported, and that the Kafka table engine works with materialized views for streaming transforms. CHKit separately claims schema and pipelines can be deployed as code. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on running continuous pipelines (only one-line mentions), detail on what CHKit 'pipelines' actually are, and independent or hands-on corroboration that MVs behave identically on the rebuilt storage layer.
